Definition: Tsephanjah, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Zephaniah is the name of four men in Scripture, and the prophet who bears it has his own book. In 2 Kings 25:18, Zephaniah the second priest. The fuller story is told on the Zephaniah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Zephaniah belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
